study: Gustav et al. 2025 — Assessing genotype-phenotype correlations in colorectal cancer with deep learning
note: Multi-target transformer, 1376 pts / 5 cohorts + 536 public. Panel: APC, BMPR2, BRAF, KRAS, RNF43, TP53, ZNRF3 + MSI + hypermutation. States high-AUROC biomarkers largely correlate with MSI.

study: Bilal et al. 2021 — IDaRS, molecular pathways and key mutations in colorectal cancer
note: TCGA-CRC-DX 502 slides. Also CIN 0.83, CIMP 0.79. Reports KRAS, PIK3CA, SMAD4, APC, WGD as NOT significantly predictable (<0.7).

study: Jang et al. 2021 — Prediction of genetic alterations from gastric cancer histopathology images
note: TCGA-STAD + institutional. Panel: CDH1, ERBB2, KRAS, PIK3CA, TP53. Only GI paper found with CDH1 as a prediction endpoint.

study: Jang et al. 2020 — Prediction of clinically actionable genetic alterations from colorectal cancer histopathology images
note: 629 TCGA + 142 Seoul St Mary. Panel: APC, KRAS, PIK3CA, SMAD4, TP53. AUROC 0.693-0.809.

study: Niehues et al. 2023 — Generalizable biomarker prediction, self-supervised deep learning
note: Panel: MSI, BRAF, KRAS, NRAS, PIK3CA. Two multicentric CRC trials + external validation.

study: Kather et al. 2020 — Pan-cancer image-based detection of clinically actionable genetic alterations
tumour: Pan-cancer (10 prevalent TCGA types, incl. COAD/READ/STAD)
note: Applied to >4000 patients across ten prevalent TCGA solid tumour types (BRCA, COAD, READ, HNSC, LUAD, LUSC, PAAD, PRAD, SKCM, STAD); screens mutations above a prevalence threshold per type. GI-specific per-gene AUROCs are in supplementary tables, not main text. Not a GI-focused design. Cohort description verified against the fetched full text (doi 10.1038/s43018-020-0087-6).

study: Fu et al. 2020 — PC-CHiP, pan-cancer computational histopathology
note: 17,355 slides. Driver mutations, CNV, expression, prognosis. Gene-by-tumour results in supplements; GI not the focus.

study: Jang et al. 2026 — AI for molecular biomarker identification in GI and hepatobiliary cancers (PRISMA systematic review)
note: Review, not a primary study: no single model or cohort. Searched 5 databases, 2015-2025. Closest thing to full-panel GI coverage in one paper.
